## CredentialService.processCredential() method

Process a received [IssueCredentialMessage](./core.issuecredentialmessage.md). This will not accept the credential or send a credential acknowledgement. It will only update the existing credential record with the information from the issue credential message. Use after calling this method to create a credential acknowledgement.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processCredential(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<IssueCredentialMessage>): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter      | Type                                                                                                                       | Description                                                |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| messageContext | [InboundMessageContext](./core.inboundmessagecontext.md)&lt;[IssueCredentialMessage](./core.issuecredentialmessage.md)&gt; | The message context containing an issue credential message |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)&gt;

credential record associated with the issue credential message
